transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ChatGPT. What brings you in today?

I don’t get any enjoyment out of the things I used to love doing, and I can’t make myself start anything anymore. My sister actually urged me to get some help because I've completely stopped touching my model railways and woodworking. I just feel like the spark has been completely switched off.
How long have you been feeling this way, and has there ever been a time like this before?
This heavy, joyless feeling has been hanging over me for about a month now, ever since my last promising contract fell through. I have never felt this way before in my life.
Have you ever had a period of feeling down or losing interest that lasted for at least two years, or has this low mood only been present for about a month?

No, I’ve never had a period of feeling down like this that lasted for two years in the past. This low, joyless feeling has really only been going on for about a month now, ever since that last contract fell through.
Over the past month, have you also been feeling down, hopeless, or guilty most days, or had changes in sleep, appetite, energy, or concentration?

Yes, I've been dealing with all of those over the past month. I feel terribly guilty and blame myself for losing my contracts, and I'm barely sleeping because I lie awake worrying about money. I also have almost no appetite, feel constantly exhausted, and my brain feels so slow that making even simple decisions is incredibly hard.
Have you had any thoughts that life is not worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

Yes, I have. Pretty regularly now I catch myself thinking it wouldn’t be so bad if I just didn’t wake up, and on a couple of really bad days I’ve even pictured how I might end things. I haven't acted on any of those thoughts, though.

Have you ever had a period lasting at least a few days where you felt unusually energized or euphoric, needed much less sleep than usual, talked more than normal, or did risky things that were out of character for you?
No, I have never experienced anything like that at all. My energy has only ever been very low, especially recently, rather than high or euphoric.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don’t, or have you had any strong beliefs that others say are not true?
No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I've never seen or heard things that weren't there, and I don't have any beliefs that others find unusual or untrue.
Have you ever had a similar episode of depression or loss of interest in the past that lasted at least two weeks and then fully went away?
No, I have never experienced anything like this before. This is the very first time in my life that I've felt this kind of persistent depression and loss of interest.
